criteria.code: writing, changing, debugging or reviewing program code
criteria.frontend: building or fixing a page, a screen or a user interface
criteria.shell: running or fixing a computer or server from the command line: Linux, SSH, services, Docker, networking
criteria.agentic: a job done by using tools over many steps: files, searches, apps, accounts
criteria.research: researching a question across many sources and reporting what they say, with references
criteria.office: a professional deliverable for a client or a boss: report, slide deck, proposal, memo, quote
criteria.security: finding, testing or fixing security weaknesses: vulnerabilities, exploits, hardening
criteria.data: queries, spreadsheets, tables and other data whose answer can be checked
criteria.ml: training, fine-tuning or debugging a machine-learning model and its dataset
criteria.cad: designing a physical part or assembly: CAD, 3D printing, tolerances, drawings
criteria.reason: logic puzzles and multi-step reasoning with no tools
criteria.write: writing or rewriting prose in one language
criteria.languages: translation and writing in languages other than English or Spanish
criteria.instruct: following a precise set of instructions or a format exactly
criteria.context: finding or combining facts inside a very long document
criteria.vision: looking at an image, a screenshot or a video frame
criteria.factual: looking up or checking a fact
criteria.health: health and medicine: symptoms, medicines and doses, medicinal plants, when to see a doctor
criteria.general: none of the above, or a mix with no clear leader
